description:
Create a professional tri-fold brochure for the 'Spring 2026 Wellness Expo' using Apache OpenOffice Writer. 

1. Open Apache OpenOffice Writer.
2. Configure the document layout: Set the page orientation to LANDSCAPE and configure the page layout to use 3 COLUMNS (Format > Page > Columns). Ensure there is at least 0.5 inches of spacing between columns.
3. Open the content file at `/home/ga/Documents/brochure_assets/content.txt` and copy the text into your brochure.
4. Insert the provided images from `/home/ga/Documents/brochure_assets/`: place `wellness_logo.png` on the front panel (right column) and `photo_activity.jpg` in the center panel.
5. Format the headings (e.g., 'Event Schedule', 'About Us') to be bold and distinct.
6. Save the final document as `/home/ga/Documents/wellness_expo_brochure.odt`.
